newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan March refinery operating rate at 85.9% - MITI.
newsitem.headline: Japan March refinery operating rate at 85.9% - MITI.

text.p: The utilisation rate of Japanese oil refineries was at 85.9 percent in March, up from 85.8 percent in the same month in 1996, the Ministry of International Trade and Industry (MITI) said on Friday.
The operating rate was 90.1 percent in February, the ministry said.
The operating rate for fiscal 1996/97 was 79.2 percent, down 0.2 percentage points from 79.4 percent the previous year, the Trade Ministry said.
Crude throughput amounted to 22.4 million kilolitres (kl) in March, down 0.1 percent from the same month in 1996, the second decline in a row, MITI said.
Crude throughput last fiscal year amounted to 243.5 million kl, a rise of 0.4 percent, it said.
Japan's oil companies currently have a combined refining capacity of 5.3 million barrels-per-stream-day.
